# Checkbox

**Figma:** Checkbox/Text, Checkbox/Mark (page 308:46604)  
**Import:** `import { Checkbox } from "@zen/design-system";`

Select zero, one or many independent options, or confirm a single statement.

## Use it for
- Multi-select lists, select-all with indeterminate parent.
- Consent that gates a primary action.

## Use something else for
- Instant settings → Toggle.
- One-of-many → RadioButton.

## Figma → React
| Figma | Prop | Values / notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Select | `checked / onChange` |  |
| Indeterminate | `indeterminate` | parent of a partially selected group |
| Check-Side | `checkSide` | left · right |
| Caption / Bold | `caption / bold` |  |
| Disabled | `disabled` | unavailable option (explain why in caption) |

## ✅ Do
- Always give a label; clicking the label toggles.
- Use indeterminate only for a parent whose children are partially selected; clicking resolves it.
- Explain disabled options in the caption ("Unavailable on the Free plan").

## ❌ Don't
- Don't use a checkbox for an action that happens immediately.
- Don't pre-check consent boxes for marketing.

## Accessibility
- Native checkbox; Space toggles; aria-checked=mixed for indeterminate.

## Content
- Affirmative statements ("Send me product news").

## Harness (`npm run usage:check`)
| Rule | Severity | Checks | Suppress with |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `choice/needs-label` | error | Checkbox, Radio and Toggle always carry a label. | `zen-allow-unlabelled-choice: <reason>` |
